name: Ring of the Gifted Hierophant
body:
Aura: moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot: ring; Price: 6,000 gp (1st level spell), 12,000 gp (2nd level spell), 17,000 gp (3rd level spell), Weight: —

DESCRIPTION

These druidic rings carved from hard stone or exotic wood allow any druid with the spontaneous casting ability to channel stored spell energy into not only 112 summoning spells that she hasn’t prepared ahead of time, but also a single spell from select schools. Each ring allows the spontaneous casting of a single, specific druid spell from the abjuration, enchantment, conjuration, necromancy or transmutation schools. The specific spontaneous spell is set when the ring is created, and the maximum level spell that can be spontaneously cast is 3rd. The spontaneous spell level must always be the same level as the prepared spell. For example, a 3rd-level ring could be forged to allow a druid to spontaneously exchange any 3rd-level prepared druid spell for a cure moderate wounds spell. A different ring could be forged that allows the spontaneous exchange of any 2nd-level spell for barkskin. These rings do not replace the druid’s ability to spontaneously cast summon nature’s ally spells – they simply expand it.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring; Special creator must be able to cast spells of the spell level to be spontaneously cast, summon nature’s ally (of the level equal to the spell to be spontaneously cast), plus the specific druid spell to be spontaneously cast (e.g., cure moderate wounds, etc.); Cost: 3,000 gp (1st level spell), 6,000 gp (2nd level spell), 8,500 gp (3rd level spell)
